segments.comment: wintty.c tty_message_menu() writes its PICK_ONE line with tty_putstr(WIN_MESSAGE), bypassing pline.c vpline()'s MSGTYPE lookup. The Priest's only potion stack is listed by invent.c display_pickinv() at the quaff prompt even though a MSGTYPE=hide rule matches its text; Escape cancels the first listing and typing the letter at the second --More-- selects the stack to drink.
